verdict.rationale: Temporal's docs say failed Activities are automatically retried according to developer configuration, and the SDKs expose automatic retries. A community user confirms you can retry any unit on failure and mark errors as non-retryable. However, nothing in the pack documents backoff (exponential intervals, coefficients, maximum interval), which is an explicit part of the story. missing for 10: documented backoff configuration (initial interval, backoff coefficient, max interval/attempts), in-depth retry-policy docs, hands-on corroboration of backoff behavior

support.subject: As a developer, I can configure automatic retries with backoff for failed steps or activities

citations.quote: If an Activity fails, Temporal automatically retries it based on your configuration.
They feature APIs for Workflow and Activity execution, automatic retries, and resilience mechanisms
You can retry any unit easily on failure and specify non-retryable errors.
